top.ministry: Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances & Pensions · reference only
brand.subtitle: Centralized Public Grievance Redress And Monitoring System
home.hero_title: Lodge, track and review a fictional grievance.
home.hero_text: Explore the complete CPGRAMS-style workflow using safe demo records. Nothing is sent to the Government of India, and no real grievance is filed.
home.email_notice: Demo notice: real grievances cannot be filed here. Email is not monitored. Use the official CPGRAMS portal for a real complaint.
home.about_p1: The Centralised Public Grievance Redress and Monitoring System (CPGRAMS) is the Government of India's online grievance platform. This project recreates its public-facing layout and complaint workflow for education and interface research only.
home.about_p2: Every reference, complainant, department, timeline entry and response in this application is fictional. Records are stored in a local SQLite database. You can safely test submitting, tracking, reminding and rating.
home.scope_title: Grievances outside the real portal's scope
home.scope_intro: The official portal lists subjects it does not take up for redress. The same examples are shown here for reference:
home.scope_4: Service matters of government employees unless prescribed channels are exhausted
home.whats_new_1: Demo release 1.0: complete lodge, status, reminder and feedback workflow.
home.whats_new_2: Hindi and Tamil interface translations added for core navigation and messages.
home.whats_new_3: Optional dashboard adapter and JSON/CSV export documented.
home.quick_lodge_text: Create a fictional complaint and receive a demo reference.
home.quick_status_text: Open a stored complaint and its event timeline.
home.quick_reminder_text: Add a simulated note to an existing demo complaint.
home.step1_text: Continue as a demo user. No password, OTP or CAPTCHA is requested.
home.step2_text: Choose a category, department and state, then submit a clearly fictional complaint.
home.step3_text: Use the generated reference and verification code to view the timeline, add a clarification or rate a closed case.
home.cta_title: Ready to explore the full flow?
home.cta_text: The demo takes about two minutes and stores everything only on this machine.
lang.fallback_notice: Full translations are available in English, Hindi and Tamil. English is shown for the selected language.
